notes.title: Another Dawn Major Update 1.04!
notes.content:
Hello guys,

we just updated Another Dawn to [b]version 1.04[/b], now including:

 - keyboard and gamepad custom key bindings
 - camera inversion option
 - reduced camera sensitivity and improved aim mode
 - AI improved
 - minor bug fixes

Moreover, Lunar Year Sales started today and Another Dawn will be [b]discounted 70%[/b] up to next week!

KR Games team

notes.title: Another Dawn major 1.03 update!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

while preparing for the Xbox and PlayStation launch in early 2021, we are also working hard to keep the PC version of the game up to date as we feel like changes are needed.

The new major 1.03 patch includes many fixes and some additions too, among which:

- AI minor fixes
- Audio minor fixes
- Settings menu checkboxes now work and keep saved preferences between sessions
- Gamepad controls change (B to crouch, RB to reload and LB to aim)
- Crouching is now "press once" (removed the old "press and hold")
- Swimming is now much more realistic and the floating works correctly
- New assets and styles

Also, do not forget about Autumn and Winter sales starting today on Steam!

KR Games

notes.title: FULL RELEASE OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

the FULL RELEASE of [b]Another Dawn[/b] is OUT NOW!

The team worked hard in the last few weeks in order to improve the quality of our game before release, and here is a list of things we did in today's FR (build 1.02):

[i]- improved AI and better scaling of difficulty
- water and food resourse balance improved
- lights and real time shadows improved
- better localization
- minor bugs fixed[/i]

We waited for long and we are very excited to finally be able to push the green button and make the game available to all of you as promised!

KR Games team

notes.title: New EA 1.01 update live!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

we just released an update for Another Dawn.

Here is the list of fixes and adds that the version EA 1.01 brings with it:

- Cloud saves added
- Mask wear/unwear fix while animations are running
- Animals are now more realistically behaving
- Enemies AI improved
- Various lights fixes
- Some finishing and clean up
- Performance improvement

Thanks for your support, we hope to able to launch our final release before Christmas!

KR Games team
